spans.s:
m. (-मिः)
1 A worm, an insect.
2 Lac, which is the accumulation of an insect.
3 A worm in the intestines.
E.
क्रम to go, इन् Uṇādi affix, and इट् inserted; also कृमि.

m. (-कः)
A medicinal plant, commonly Bireng: see कृमिकण्टक.

mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं)
Vermifuge, anthelmintic.
m. (-घ्नः)
An anthelmintic shrub: see कृमिघ्न.
f. (-घ्नी)
Somraj, (Serratula or Conyza anthelmintica.)
E.
कृमि or क्रिमि a worm, and घ्न what kills: see कृमिघ्न.

n. (-जं)
Aguru or aloe wood: see अगुरु.
f. (-जा)
The red dye called Lac.
E.
-क्रिमि a worm, and ज born; also कृमिज.

m. (-त्रुः)
The coral tree, (Erythrina fulgens.)
E.
क्रिमि a worm, and शत्रु an enemy; the leaves yield, by expression, an acrid anthelmintic juice.

m. (-वः)
A fetid mimosa, (M. farnesiana.)
E.
क्रिमि a worm, and शात्रव inimical: an anthelmintic.

m. (-लः)
An ant hill.
E.
क्रिमि a worm, and शेल a hill.

m. (-यः)
The sign Aries.
E.
कृ to do, श aff.

f. (-या)
1 An act, action, acting.
2 Means, expedient.
3 Beginning, undertaking.
4

Atonement.
5

Study.
6

Worship.
7

Disquisition.
8

Bodily action.
9 Remedying, physical treatment or practice.
10 Instrument, implement.
11 A religious or initiatory ceremony.
12 Obsequies, rites performed immediately after death.
12 Purificatory rites, as ablution, &c.
14 Judicial investigation, by human means, as witnesses, documents, &c. or by superhuman or ordeals of various kinds.
15 In grammar, a verb of two kinds, सकर्म्मक्रिया active or अकर्म्मक्रिया intransitive.
16 A noun of action.
E.
कृ to act, to do, श affix, fem. do. टाप्; the above meanings may be all resolved into the first.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Doing, making, engaged in.
E.
कृ to do, शानच् aff.

m. (-रः)
See the next.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
One who does any act, an agent, a performer.
m. (-रः)
A student, a novice, a tyro.
E.
क्रिया study, and कर or कार, who makes.

mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि)
Opposed or averse to any act.
m. (-षी)
One of the five kinds of witnesses, he whose testimony is hurtful to the cause.
E.
क्रिया a suit, and द्वेषिन् injuring.

m. (-शः)
Evidence.
E.
क्रिया, and निर्देश proof.

mfn. (-पः-पा-पं)
Conformably to the act, according to the action.
E.
क्रिया, and अनुरूप like to.

mfn. (-टुः-टुः-टु)
Clever, dexterous.
E.
क्रिया, and पटु clever.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Attentive to or diligent in the performance of their duties.
E.
क्रिया, and पर engaged in.

m. (-र्गः)
1 End of an affair.
2 Liberation from ceremonial acts.
E.
क्रिया, and अपवर्ग end.

m. (-दः)
The third division of a suit at law, the proof or rejoinder of the plaintiff.
E.
क्रिवा an affair, and पाद a fourth part.

m. (-ङ्गः)
Course of proceeding.
E.
क्रिया, and प्रसङ्ग procedure.

n. (-लं)
Result or consequence of acts.
E.
क्रिया, and फल fruit.

m. (-मः)
Special compact or agreement.
E.
क्रिया business, अभि and उप prefixed to गम to go, affix अच्; going through with any thing.

m. (-पः)
Discontinuance or loss of any of the essential ceremonies of the Hindu religion.
E.
क्रिया, and लोप loss.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
1 Engaged in business.
2 Understanding business, fit for it, possessed of worldly knowledge.
2 Celebrating religious rites.
E.
क्रिया, and मतुप् aff.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
Subject to the influence of acts.
m. (-शः)
Necessity, necessary influence of acts done or to be done.
E.
क्रिया, and वश subjection.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
One who loses his cause in a lawsuit.
E.
क्रिया affair, अवसन्न ended.

m. (-दी)
A plaintiff.
E.
क्रिया affair, and वादिन् who declares.

f. (-धिः)
1 Conduct of affairs.
2 Mode of performing any rite.
E.
क्रिया, and विधि rule.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
1 Conversant with business.
2 Understanding the ritual, &c.
E.
क्रियाविधि, and ज्ञ who knows.

m. (-रः)
Repetition of any act, doing any thing repeatedly.
E.
क्रिया, and समभिहार repetition.

m. (-यः)
An organ of action, as the hand, foot, voice, organ of generation and that of excretion.
E.
क्रिया acting, and इन्द्रिय an organ; also कर्म्मेंन्द्रिय.

(डु, ङ्,) डुक्रीङ् r. 9th cl. (क्रीणाति क्रीणीते)
To buy, to barter or exchange;
with वि prefixed,
to sell.

r. 1st cl. (ऋ) क्रीडृ (क्रीडति)
To play, to sport;
with अनु, अव, आङ्, परि, or सम् prefixed, it is deponent,
as अनुक्रीडते, &c. unless अनु requires the accusative case, and the compound with सम् implies inarticulate sound, as तमनुक्रीडति सा she plays with him, संक्रीडति चक्रं the wheel creaks.

mfn. (-डः-डा)
1 Sport, play, pastime, pleasure, amusement.
f. (-डा)
1 Playing, as a ball, &c.
2 Disrespect.
E.
क्रीड to play, अ affix, and fem. do. टाप्.

n. (-नं)
Play, sport, &c.
E.
क्रीड to play, affix युच्.

mfn. (-डन्-डन्ती-डत्)
Playing, gamboling, sporting.
E.
क्रीड, and शतृ aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Sporting, playing.
E.
क्रीड, and शानच् aff.

n. (-तं)
Sportive or wanton purpose or desire.
E.
क्रीडा, and आकूत wish.

m. (-पः)
Assumed anger, anger in sport.
E.
क्रीडा, and कोप anger.

n. (-त्नं)
Copulation.
E.
क्रीडा, and रत्न a gem.

m. (-थः)
A car, a carriage.
E.
क्रीडा sport, pleasure, and रथ a car.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Sporting, sportive.
E.
क्रीडा, and मतुप् aff.

n. (-रः)
A reservoir, a basin.
E.
क्रीडा pleasure, सरस् a lake.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Bought, purchased.
m. (-तः)
A son, one of the twelve kinds acknowledged by the ancient Hindu law; he who is purchased from his natural parents.
E.
क्री to buy, affix क्त.

m. (-कः)
A son bought from his natural parents, and adopted as male issue; also क्रीत and क्रीतपुत्त्रः see the preceding.

m. (-यः)
Returning a purchase upon the seller, admissible in some cases by law.
E.
क्रीत bought, अनुशय repentance.
